items.title: Sichuan Neautus Traditional Chinese Medicine Co., Ltd. (02206)
items.en_title: Sichuan Neautus Traditional Chinese Medicine Co., Ltd. (02206)
items.en_oneliner: Traditional Chinese medicine company Neautus listed on 11 November at an offer range of HK$40.20-50.55. It closed its first day up 71.64%, after rising 23.23% in the grey market.
